LanguageData.Gun_MP5K_RWP.description: The MP5K is a compact submachine gun known for its rapid rate of fire and exceptional handling. Its lightweight design makes it ideal for quick, close-quarters engagements, but its effectiveness decreases at longer ranges. Reliable and efficient, the MP5K is favored by those needing a balance of maneuverability and firepower.
